profile.summary: wenz is a JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in jQuery, particularly the AJAX module's URL construction and caching behavior. Their contributions focus on fixing edge cases in legacy JavaScript codebases, demonstrating strong debugging skills and deep understanding of jQuery's internals. While their experience is confined to frontend development with jQuery (a pre-ES6 library), they show proficiency in asynchronous patterns (jQuery Deferred) and client-side API consumption. No evidence of modern JavaScript frameworks, TypeScript, or backend development skills is present in their contributions. Their experience level is assessed as Mid due to focused contributions to a mature library and demonstrated ability to identify and resolve complex edge cases in legacy code.
